title: Nose and Ear Expressions

image.attribution: Author assumed: World Imaging / Wikimedia Commons / CC-BY-SA-3.0

main_content:
A person’s nose is important for breathing and smelling. The nose is also used in many popular expressions.

Some people are able to “lead other people by the nose.” For example, if a wife “leads her husband by the nose,” she makes him do whatever she wants him to do.

It is always helpful when people “keep their nose out of other people’s business” – they do not interfere. The opposite of this is someone who “noses around all the time.” This kind of person is interested in other people’s private matters. He is “nosey.”

I think we have explained the nose expressions. What about ears? Well, I hope you are “all ears,” or very interested in hearing more expressions.

If you are a good person, you will “lend an ear” to your friends. You will listen to them when they have a problem they need to talk about. Our last expression is “to play it by ear” - this has two meanings. One is to play a song on a musical instrument by remembering the tune. “Play it by ear” also means to decide what to do at the last minute instead of making detailed plans.

options: Keep your nose out of it

questions.question: If you control someone, what is that called?
options: To lead someone by the nose
